name: Home project
summary: Plan a home project with tasks in order, a supply list and invites for your helpers.

onboarding.prompt: Does any part need a licensed pro (electrical, gas, structural)?
onboarding.reaction: We'll add a booking step if so.

plan_blueprint.calendar: Work sessions on the chosen slots, a supply run, helper invites, and the deadline.

approach_variants.habit: Short sessions on the same days each week; streak of sessions done.
approach_variants.willpower: Weekend sprint challenge to finish a big chunk, with a countdown to the deadline.
approach_variants.time: Every task becomes a calendar block in order; weekly review of time and tasks left.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward at halfway and when the project is done.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers tools, supplies, quotes and helpers before any work starts.

guardrails: For lifting, ladders, power tools or electrical and gas work, use proper safety gear and hire a licensed professional where required.
Check local permit rules before structural, electrical or plumbing work.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
restart_rules: Missed sessions push tasks back in order; if the deadline is at risk, the plan suggests more helpers or a new date.
